parameters.description: Retrieve a filtered list of conversations for a specific contact by its ID. This parameter cannot be used in conjunction with the `inboxId` property.

parameters.name: association
parameters.description: You can specify an association type here of `TICKET`. If this is set the response will included a thread associations object and associated ticket id if present. If there are no associations to a ticket with this conversation, then the thread associations object will not be present on the response.

parameters.name: inboxId
parameters.description: The ID of the conversations inbox you can optionally include to retrieve the associated messages for. This parameter cannot be used in conjunction with the `associatedContactId` property.

parameters.name: latestMessageTimestampAfter
parameters.description: The minimum(earliest) `latestMessageTimestamp`. This is required only when sorting by `latestMessageTimestamp`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: A specific property to include in the thread response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Set the sort order of the response. Valid options are `id` (default) and `latestMessageTimestamp` (which requires the `latestMessageTimestampAfter` field to also be set). If you’re filtering threads by `associatedContactId` , you can sort in descending order by prepending - to the sort option (e.g., `-id` or `-latestMessageTimestampAfter` ). Otherwise, results are always returned in ascending order.

parameters.name: threadStatus
parameters.description: The status of the associated conversations to filter by (either `OPEN` or `CLOSED`). This property must be provided if you’re including the `associatedContactId` query parameter.

post.description: Create a new custom channel integration in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to define the capabilities and properties of the custom channel, such as its name, description, and webhook URL. The request must include a JSON body with the necessary details for the new channel integration.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Generate an identification token for a website visitor who has been authenticated using your own system. An identification token returned from this API can be used to pass information about your already-authenticated visitor to the chat widget, so that it treats the visitor as a known contact. This allows support agents to recognize and assist the visitor more effectively.

channelLogoUrl.description: A string representing the URL of the channel's logo.

name.description: A string representing the name of the channel.

webhookUrl.description: A string representing the URL to which webhook events will be sent.

capabilities.description: An object that defines the capabilities of the channel. This can include various properties that describe what the channel can do.

channelAccountConnectionRedirectUrl.description: An object representing the URL used to redirect for channel account connection.

channelDescription.description: An object containing the description of the channel.

channelLogoUrl.description: An object representing the URL of the channel's logo.

name.description: An object representing the name of the channel.

webhookUrl.description: An object representing the URL for the webhook associated with the channel.

errorMessage.description: A string containing an error message, if applicable.

statusType.description: Valid status are SENT, FAILED, and READ

clientType.description: The type of client interacting with the API. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT', 'SYSTEM', 'INTEGRATION', and 'UNKNOWN'.

integrationAppId.description: The unique identifier for the integration application associated with this client. It is an integer value.

type.description: A string indicating the type of the component, which is 'CONTACT' by default.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether the message is archived.

attachments.description: An array of attachments included with the message, which can be files, locations, contacts, or other supported types.

channelAccountId.description: The identifier of the channel account associated with the message.

channelId.description: The identifier of the channel through which the message was sent.

conversationsThreadId.description: The identifier for the conversation thread to which this message belongs.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the message was created, in ISO 8601 format.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the message.

direction.description: The direction of the message, either 'INCOMING' or 'OUTGOING'.

id.description: The unique identifier for the message.

inReplyToId.description: The identifier of the message to which this message is a reply, if applicable.

recipients.description: An array of recipients of the message, each containing recipient details.

richText.description: The rich text content of the message, if available.

senders.description: An array of senders associated with the message, each containing sender details.

subject.description: The subject of the message, if applicable.

text.description: The plain text content of the message.

truncationStatus.description: Indicates whether the message content is truncated. Valid values are 'NOT_TRUNCATED', 'TRUNCATED_TO_MOST_RECENT_REPLY', and 'TRUNCATED'.

type.description: The type of the message, which is always 'MESSAGE'.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the message was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

type.description: A string representing the type of delivery identifier. Valid values include 'HS_EMAIL_ADDRESS', 'HS_PHONE_NUMBER', 'HS_SHORT_CODE', and 'CHANNEL_SPECIFIC_OPAQUE_ID'.

value.description: A string representing the value associated with the delivery identifier type.

fileId.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the file.

fileUsageType.description: A string specifying the usage type of the file, which can be 'STICKER', 'VOICE_RECORDING', 'IMAGE', 'AUDIO', or 'OTHER'.

name.description: A string containing the name of the file.

type.description: A string indicating the type of the attachment, which is always 'FILE'.

url.description: A string containing the URL where the file can be accessed.

address.description: A string representing the address of the location.

latitude.description: A number representing the latitude of the location.

longitude.description: A number representing the longitude of the location.

name.description: A string representing the name of the location.

type.description: A string that specifies the type of the component, which is 'LOCATION'.

url.description: A string representing a URL associated with the location.

errorMessage.description: A string containing a human-readable description of the error that occurred during message delivery.

errorMessageTokens.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a token name and each value is a string. These tokens provide additional context or details related to the error message.

fileId.description: An integer representing the ID of an associated file, formatted as an int64.

text.description: A string containing the text content of the message header.

type.description: A string indicating the type of message header. The default and only valid value is 'MESSAGE_HEADER'.

statusType.description: The current status of the message. Valid values include 'SENT', 'FAILED', 'RECEIVED', and 'READ'.

allowMultiSelect.description: A boolean indicating whether multiple quick replies can be selected by the user.

allowUserInput.description: A boolean indicating whether the user is allowed to input their own response in addition to selecting from the quick replies.

quickReplies.description: An array of QuickReply objects, each representing a single quick reply option available to the user.

type.description: A string indicating the type of the component, which is 'QUICK_REPLIES'.

actorId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the actor associated with the recipient.

name.description: A string representing the name of the recipient.

recipientField.description: A string representing a specific field related to the recipient.

actorId.description: The unique identifier for the sender, represented as a string.

name.description: The name of the sender, represented as a string.

senderField.description: A string field associated with the sender, its specific use is not detailed in the spec.

type.description: A string indicating the type of attachment, which is 'SOCIAL_MEDIA_METADATA'.
A string that specifies the type of unsupported content. The default and only valid value is 'UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT'.

contentId.description: An integer representing the content ID associated with the template. This is a 64-bit integer.

crmObjectIds.description: An object mapping CRM object types to their respective IDs, where each ID is a 64-bit integer.

mappedTemplateId.description: An integer representing the ID of the mapped template. This is a 64-bit integer.

parameters.description: An object containing key-value pairs of parameters used for template customization, where each value is a string.

rootMicId.description: An integer representing the root message interaction context ID. This is a 64-bit integer.

type.description: A string indicating the type of metadata, which is 'WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_METADATA'.

quickReplies.description: An array of QuickReply objects, each representing a predefined option that a user can select.

type.description: A string indicating the type of attachment. The default value is 'QUICK_REPLIES'.

label.description: The label displayed to the user for the quick reply option. It is a string.

value.description: The value associated with the quick reply, typically used as the response when the quick reply is selected. It is a string.

valueType.description: The type of the value, indicating how the value should be interpreted. It is a string and can be either 'TEXT' or 'URL'.

description.description: A description of the media content.

id.description: The unique identifier for this media content.

mediaTitle.description: The title of the media content.

mediaType.description: The type of media content, such as 'PHOTO', 'VIDEO', 'CAROUSEL', 'LINK', 'ARTICLE', 'GIF', 'DOCUMENT', 'POLL', 'NONE', 'STORY', or 'AUDIO'.

mediaUrl.description: The URL where the media content is located.

mediaUrlString.description: A string representing the URL of the media content.

thumbnailUrl.description: The URL of the thumbnail image for the media content.

type.description: A string indicating the type of attachment, which is 'SOCIAL_MEDIA_METADATA'.
A string indicating the type of the attachment. The default value is 'UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT'.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error

VisitorIdentificationError.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error

VisitorIdentificationErrorDetail.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

email.description: The email of the visitor that you wish to identify

firstName.description: The first name of the visitor that you wish to identify. This value will only be set in HubSpot for new contacts and existing contacts where first name is unknown. Optional.

hsCustomerAgentContext.description: An object containing additional context about the customer agent. This field is required and can include various string properties.

lastName.description: The last name of the visitor that you wish to identify. This value will only be set in HubSpot for new contacts and existing contacts where last name is unknown. Optional.

token.description: An identification token that allows the visitor to be treated as a known contact.
